#include <tunables/global>

################################################################################
# EXPERIMENTAL: Custom AppArmor profile for Home Assistant Add-on
# Generated by HAOS Add-on Converter
################################################################################

profile haos_app_converter flags=(attach_disconnected,mediate_deleted) {
  #include <abstractions/base>
  #include <abstractions/bash>
  #include <abstractions/nameservice>

  /bin/** rmix,
  /usr/bin/** rmix,
  /usr/local/bin/** rmix,
  /opt/** rmix,
  /tmp/** rwk,
  /run/** r,
  /start.sh r,
  /run.sh r,
  /dev/stdout rw,
  /dev/stderr rw,
  /dev/fd/* r,

  network inet stream,
  network inet6 stream,
  network inet dgram,
  network inet6 dgram,
  network unix,

  /data/ rwk,
  /data/** rwk,
  /addons/ rwk,
  /addons/** rwk,
}
